name: The Great Square before the Factories, Canton
dimensions: Dimensions taken from <u>Victoria & Albert Museum Department of Prints and Drawings and Department of Paintings, Accessions 1928. </u> London: HMSO, 1929
summary:
A view from the west of the premises of the European and American trading bases - known as 'factories' or 'hongs' - ranged along the north bank of the Pearl River in Canton (Guangzhou), the only Chinese port open to trade with the West at this time.
